people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
translations.bsb: Absalom did this to all the Israelites who came to the king for justice. In this way he stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
translations.kjv: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
translations.asv: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
